english.note: This is the all-purpose term for carbon monoxide gas.

examples.english: The gas stove leaked, and a lot of carbon monoxide built up in the house—it was really dangerous.
examples.traditional: 煤氣爐漏氣，屋企積咗好多一氧化碳，真係好危險。
